title: root_signature.json binding-vector note still says 'LICHEN native' (should say upstream Yggdrasil)
description: From 1p2r.4 codereview pass 2. test/vectors/root_signature.json final vector (binding_valid: true) note reads 'DODAGID == AddrForKey(pubkey), LICHEN native 0200::/8 address'. Post-migration the DODAGID is upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey; 'LICHEN native' is the rejected SHA-512 profile's branding. Reword to 'upstream Yggdrasil 0200::/8 address' (0200::/8 itself stays correct).
close_reason: Note reworded to 'upstream Yggdrasil 0200::/8 address'; matches corpus header and settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision. Schema test green; reviewer confirmed no consumer parses note.
